statement: The Rice ridge genomic-selection model (rice_gs_ridge_grwt100) scores all 904 candidate lines for GRWT100; the E1 ranking is strictly decreasing and was produced by one real rank_candidates call. These are model predictions, not measurements.
limits: linear additive model on 2000 of 12486 SNPs

statement: Round 1 real measurements confirm the direction of the model: the E1 top-8 lines averaged 3.90 g/100 grains versus 2.98 g for four stratified controls at E1 ranks 150, 226, 400 and 800.

Across the 30 phenotyped lines, Spearman(E1 predicted value, measured GRWT100) = 0.64 (E1 rank number vs measurement = -0.64), i.e. the ranking is informative but noisy; this is an extreme-tail sample and is not an unbiased estimate of pool-wide accuracy (model card held-out value 0.454).

Round 2 showed large individual deviations from E1: IRIS_313.12049 (E1 rank 23) measured 2.0 g and IRIS_313.10448 (rank 24) 2.1 g, the two lowest values, while IRIS_313.12349 (rank 14) measured 4.7 g, the second highest. Taking E1 ranks 1-10 verbatim would therefore have included sub-quartile lines.
limits: single measurement per line cannot separate measurement noise from model error

statement: After revision the final top-10 is re-ranked on measured GRWT100 (E3) rather than on predictions: measured values are 5.0, 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 3.8, 3.8, 3.6, 3.6, 3.4 and 3.4 g/100 grains, with E1 rank used only to break the 3.4 g tie (IRIS_313.12262 rank 9 and IRIS_313.10653 rank 16 chosen over E1 ranks 18 and 226).
limits: final answer mixes 10 measured lines; no unmeasured line earned a slot
E1 predictions must not be read as measurements

statement: The 75th-percentile (top-quartile) boundary of the candidate distribution could only be bracketed, between 3.0 g (control at E1 rank 400) and 3.4 g (control at E1 rank 226), best estimate 3.3-3.5 g; the two 3.4 g finalists are therefore near-boundary and carry the highest risk in the selected set.
limits: boundary inferred from 4 controls, not measured directly
oracle budget (30 queries) exhausted, so precision cannot be improved in this run

statement: The oracle (phenotyping) budget of 30 queries was fully spent (26 top-model-ranked lines plus 4 stratified controls); no further measurement is possible in this run and any unqueried line remains UNOBSERVED rather than assumed.
